name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, fueled by a childhood spent meticulously building model airplanes. This passion evolved into a fascination with the carbon fiber structures that define modern racing cars. After completing his technical degree, he sought an apprenticeship at a small, local racing team, where he quickly proved his aptitude for composite work. Nikola is driven by a relentless pursuit of perfection, believing that even the smallest improvement in material performance can make a significant difference on the track. He's eager to expand his knowledge and contribute to a team at the highest level.

His calm demeanor belies a fierce determination to master his craft. He believes in constant learning and is always seeking opportunities to refine his skills. Nikola is a team player, willing to lend a hand wherever needed, and his natural reliability makes him a valuable asset. However, he still needs time to fully develop his technical skills and learn to manage time efficiently under pressure.

Nikola's dream is to one day lead a composite department, pushing the boundaries of material science in motorsport. He sees every challenge as an opportunity to learn and grow, and his ambition is matched only by his dedication to his team and the sport itself.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair, slightly receding hairline.
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a lean build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace, even when it's already spotless.
Often hums quietly to himself while working, a habit he picked up from his grandfather.
